data.vendor: daily: Sharadar SEP/TICKERS/ACTIONS (sequential vendor pulls); intraday: Alpaca SIP raw 1-minute bars

related_programs.exposed_findings_window: 2016-01-01..2016-03-31 (development diagnostic; private; prior_exposure in the successor ledger)
related_programs.rule_provenance: Q1-informed development, not an independently conceived or data-calibrated threshold; one value declared, no alternatives evaluated or compared
frozen_definitions: eligibility: 2 * base_bps_per_side / 1e4 * trigger / (trigger - or_low) <= ceiling (inclusive boundary), base 5 bps per side
non-positive or non-finite risk -> INVALID_RISK, never eligible
entry trigger = or_high + 1 tick; stop = or_low; exits E1 (time) and E2a (fixed 2R)
disclosure: gap fills make actual entry risk and cost differ from the trigger-based estimate
related_programs.reserved_evaluation_window: 2017-01-01..2017-06-30 (development_selection partition; not P3B confirmation; 2020-2021 and the holdout preserved); reservation only, acquisition and run are separate decisions

related_programs.tier_choice: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED: P (positive evidence only) or P+E (adds complete-empty same-provider responses)

minute_classes.ACCOUNTED_NO_BAR_ELIGIBLE_PRINT: a no-bar minute examined by a frozen census with a COMPLETE trades response (pagination followed to the end of the interval), symbol identity and query boundaries verified (every stored-bar control minute in the window returned >=1 bar-eligible trade; all returned timestamps inside the window), no suspected common-provider gap (>=10% of the day's symbols lack a bar at that minute) and either (P) trades present, every one documented as NOT updating a minute bar, or (E) no trade returned
minute_classes.DATA_GAP: every other no-bar minute: incomplete or unverified evidence, a suspected provider gap, or bar-eligible trades present with no bar (a data defect)

related_programs.bar_eligibility_rule: provider-documented condition table for MINUTE bars (Alpaca Market Data FAQ); strictest rule when a trade has several conditions; code B updates only on tape C; a trade with no condition list is treated as eligible
related_programs.or_levels: max(high) and min(low) over VALID_BAR minutes inside 09:30:00-09:59:59 ET; accounted minutes contribute nothing; no bar or opening price is ever synthesised
related_programs.or_valid_when: zero DATA_GAP minutes in the opening range (or_completeness_rule 0, unchanged) AND at least one VALID_BAR in it
or_invalid_despite_accounted_minutes: any DATA_GAP minute in the opening range
no VALID_BAR in the opening range
a bar-eligible trade present in a minute with no bar
a suspected common-provider gap minute in the range
related_programs.gate: or-valid member-days / expected member-days >= 0.98; the expected population (denominator) is unchanged; tier P and tier E counts are reported separately
related_programs.tolerance: none: no missing-minute count tolerance is used
related_programs.scope: prospective; applies to 2017-H1 after adoption; never re-grades Q1 or any earlier run
related_programs.evaluation_scope: development-partition evidence, not untouched P3B confirmation; data-quality diagnostics preceded any strategy result; strategy rule Q1-informed
